description: A bidirectional, composable transformation between two feature lexicon namespaces.

main.description: A lens record stored in an ATProto PDS. Declarative rules or a WASM module ref.

id.description: Unique identifier for this lens, e.g. 'org.commonmark.to.html.v1'.

version.description: Semver version of this lens, e.g. '1.0'. Metadata only — not used during application or composition.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this lens transforms.

rules.description: Declarative transform rules. Mutually exclusive with wasmModule.

passthrough.description: Behavior for features not matched by any rule.

wasmModule.description: WASM module reference for complex transforms. Takes precedence over rules.

rule.description: A single transform rule: match a feature and replace or drop it.

replace.description: The replacement descriptor, or null to drop the feature entirely.

featurePattern.description: Pattern to match against a feature's $type and optional name field.

typeId.description: $type string, compound key '$type#name', or ATProto compound type 'app.bsky.richtext.facet#mention'. '@version' suffixes are stripped before comparison (e.g. 'org.commonmark.facet#strong@0.31' matches a feature with name 'strong'). If omitted, defaults to the lens's 'source' NSID.

name.description: If set, also match the feature's 'name' data field. '@version' suffixes are stripped on both sides.

featureReplacement.description: How to rewrite a matched feature.

typeId.description: New $type for the output feature. If omitted, defaults to the lens's 'target' NSID.

name.description: New name field value (omit to clear the name field).

addAttrs.description: Inject constant attributes into the output feature.

dropAttrs.description: Remove these attribute keys from the output feature.

keepAttrs.description: Whitelist: keep only these attribute keys (plus $type and name). Applied last, after all other operations. Prefer over dropAttrs when the full attribute set is known.

mapAttrValue.description: Transform attribute values by key. Each value is an attrValueOp descriptor. Applied after renameAttrs and before addAttrs.

attrValueOp.description: A value transform operation. 'op' selects the transform; 'value' is the operand (number for numeric ops, string for string ops; omit for unary ops). Numeric ops (add/subtract/multiply) are no-ops on non-numbers; string ops (prefix/suffix) are no-ops on non-strings; negate is a no-op on non-booleans.

value.description: Operand: number for add/subtract/multiply; string for prefix/suffix.

wasmLensRef.description: Reference to a WebAssembly lens module binary.

cid.description: Content-addressed CID of the WASM binary (for ATProto blob storage).

url.description: HTTP URL for fetching the WASM binary (URL fallback).

data.description: Inline base64-encoded WASM binary (for testing and small modules).

importFn.description: Name of the WASM export function: rawString → DocumentJSON. Called when lens source starts with 'raw:'.

exportFn.description: Name of the WASM export function: DocumentJSON → rawString. Called when lens target starts with 'raw:'.
